threads.body: `getDestinationName` can now return `null`, and while `createMessageWithTopic` was updated to guard against this, the parallel `createMessageWithQueue` (line 56) was not. When `getQueueName()` throws (e.g. a `JMSException` from the provider), `getDestinationName` returns `null` and `queueName.startsWith(TIBCO_TMP_PREFIX)` will throw a `NullPointerException`. The queue path needs the same null guard that was added to the topic path here.
